# www.no-bs-junkremoval.com llms.txt

> No BS Junk Removal is the junk removal and hauling division of No-BS Yardwork in
> Winnipeg, Manitoba. Upfront pricing with labour, hauling and disposal included, a
> skid steer and dump trailer for heavy material, and certified recycling for
> appliances and e-waste. Call or text 204.900.0438.

## Pages

- [Junk Removal Winnipeg](https://www.no-bs-junkremoval.com/): Winnipeg junk removal with upfront pricing and no hidden fees. Furniture, appliances, reno debris, hot tubs, concrete. Skid steer available.
- [Pricing](https://www.no-bs-junkremoval.com/pricing): You pay for the space your junk takes up in the trailer. Labour, hauling and dump fees included. Heavy material is priced by weight because the landfill charges by the tonne.
- [What We Take](https://www.no-bs-junkremoval.com/what-we-take): Furniture, appliances, mattresses, e-waste, renovation debris, hot tubs, sheds and decks, concrete, yard waste, estate cleanouts, scrap metal and pianos.
- [Hot Tub Removal Winnipeg](https://www.no-bs-junkremoval.com/hot-tub-removal-winnipeg): Disconnect, on-site breakdown into haulable sections, and same-visit haul-away without damaging decks or fences.
- [Appliance Removal Winnipeg](https://www.no-bs-junkremoval.com/appliance-removal-winnipeg): Fridges, freezers, washers, dryers and furnaces taken to a certified recycler with refrigerant recovered by a certified technician.
- [Concrete Removal Winnipeg](https://www.no-bs-junkremoval.com/concrete-removal-winnipeg): Concrete, brick, patio stone, asphalt and aggregate removed with a skid steer and weight-rated dump trailer, priced by the tonne.
- [Commercial Junk Removal & Skid Steer Services](https://www.no-bs-junkremoval.com/commercial-junk-removal-winnipeg): Commercial lot cleanups, construction debris, full demolition and turnover cleanouts. Contractor accounts with net terms and priority scheduling.
- [Winter Services](https://www.no-bs-junkremoval.com/winter-services-winnipeg): Snow removal and off-site snow hauling, winter cleanouts, off-season demolition and job site debris.
- [About](https://www.no-bs-junkremoval.com/about): No BS Junk Removal is No-BS Yardwork with a bigger trailer. Same owners, same crews, same phone.
- [Where Your Junk Actually Goes](https://www.no-bs-junkremoval.com/where-your-junk-goes): Exactly which facility each material stream goes to, and the honest business reason for diverting it.
- [Reviews](https://www.no-bs-junkremoval.com/reviews): Reviews carried over from the No-BS Yardwork landscaping side, clearly labelled, while the junk division collects its own.
- [Get a Quote](https://www.no-bs-junkremoval.com/quote): Text a photo, call, or fill out the form. Free on-site estimates.

## Things we do not take

Wet paint, solvents, chemicals, pesticides, asbestos or suspected asbestos,
propane tanks, fuel, oil, explosives, medical or biohazard waste, ammunition.
